display_title: Naughty Things with My Young Wife
description:
Beom Dogun, the man who saved me from the depths of despair. Unlike the past, when he crushed my confession by calling me a 'little baby who needs protection'... this man is acting the role of a husband a little too well. By day, he is the most reliable guardian in the world, but once night falls, he turns into a beast, obsessed with me and refusing to let me go.
